tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Fricke and torus coordinates] 1. Theorem 5.3.6,Theorem 5.3.7\group Teichmuller theorySource: thurston:page-0104 For a hyperbolic surface with geodesic boundary, the Fricke space is $\R ^{-3\chi (M)}$; boundary curves carry no twist coordinate. The Teichmuller space of a unit-area flat torus is $\R ^2$ with coordinates $(\log l,\tau )$ in a chosen primitive free homotopy class.
